message.title: Ex dividend USD 0.03 today – Jacktel AS
message.body:
The shares in Jacktel AS will be traded ex dividend of USD 0.03 per share as of today, 01 September 2026. Please note that the payment will be made in NOK at NOK 0.2802 per share. The payment will be made on 11 September 2026. 

The dividend shall be classified as repayment of paid-in capital for tax purposes. 
 
This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations for Euronext Growth Oslo.
